title: Market Completeness and Optional Projections under Restricted Information
abstract: arXiv:2609.28463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a finite discrete-time market, trading decisions may be predictable with respect to a filtration that does not adapt asset prices. The first fundamental theorem then characterizes absence of arbitrage by measures under which the optional projection of discounted prices is a martingale. We examine the corresponding completeness question. For a fixed projection, every claim measurable with respect to its terminal price history is attainable precisely when all equivalent martingale measures of that fixed process agree on the claim sigma-field. We give the finite-dimensional proof, retaining the distinction between the trading filtration and the claim sigma-field. If the projection is common to all optional martingale measures of the original prices, projected completeness implies uniqueness of their restrictions, but the converse fails even in a three-state model with a unique optional martingale measure. translated_title: 受限信息下的市场完备性与可选投影
translated_abstract: 在有限离散时间市场中，交易决策可以是关于一个不适应（不生成）资产价格的信息流（滤子）可预测的。此时，资产定价第一基本定理通过“贴现价格的可选投影为鞅”的测度来刻画无套利条件。我们研究相应的市场完备性问题。对于固定的投影，每个关于其终端价格历史可测的未定权益都是可实现的，当且仅当该固定过程的所有等价鞅测度在未定权益的σ-域上取值一致。我们给出了有限维情形下的证明，并保留了交易滤子与权益σ-域之间的区分。如果该投影对于原始价格的所有可选鞅测度都是共同的，则投影完备性蕴含这些鞅测度在相应限制上的唯一性；但反之不成立，即使在一个具有唯一可选鞅测度的三状态模型中也是如此。对于二项式模型在其……（原文摘要至此中断）
tldr: 该论文在交易信息流不适应资产价格的受限信息框架下研究离散时间市场的完备性，证明了对固定的可选投影而言，市场完备当且仅当所有等价鞅测度在权益σ-域上一致，并进一步表明投影完备性蕴含鞅测度限制的唯一性，但反之不成立。
en_tdlr: This paper studies market completeness in finite discrete-time markets where the trading filtration does not adapt asset prices, proving that for a fixed optional projection every claim is attainable iff all equivalent martingale measures agree on the claim sigma-field, and showing that projected completeness implies uniqueness of the measures' restrictions while the converse fails.
